title: Clone in a Loop
goal: Remove both clones from the loop. Borrow instead.
hints: Every iteration pays for two Strings that are dropped immediately. Who needs ownership here? Nobody.
Passing `banner` without cloning moves it - fine once, fatal in a loop.
explanation: render only reads, so both parameters should be borrows. Cloning inside a loop multiplies the waste by the iteration count - the classic allocation leak. Note the trap: passing `banner` unclOned compiles for a single call but moves the String, so the second iteration dies with E0382. Borrow both (&banner into &str; item is already a reference), and the loop allocates nothing.
